description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating various clients to interact with Hono's northbound APIs, including telemetry, event, command response, and command clients. It provides methods for creating consumers for telemetry, events, command responses, and for obtaining command clients for specific tenants, with support for asynchronous operations and different reply-to configurations.

classes.name: ApplicationClientFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating clients to interact with Hono's northbound APIs, including telemetry, event, command response, and command clients.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ApplicationClientFactory instance for an existing HonoConnection.

methods.name: createTelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for telemetry data from Hono's Telemetry API for a specific tenant.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for events from Hono's Event API for a specific tenant, with options for settlement behavior.

methods.name: createAsyncCommandResponseConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for asynchronous command responses, with options for message handling.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client for a specific tenant.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client for a specific tenant with a custom reply-to identifier.

methods.name: getOrCreateAsyncCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an asynchronous command client for a specific tenant.
